name: Dead Probe Swarm
description: A long-dead civilisation's self-replicating probes wake in an asteroid-rich region away from the empires. They expand mining stations into nearby asteroid fields and gas giants and attack any ship that enters a system they hold. They never raid, trade or talk. Destroy the mothercore to stop them.

flags.name: threatProbeSwarm
flags.label: Dead Probe Swarm
flags.description: Self-replicating probes expand mining stations and defend every system they hold.

params.name: probeSwarmYear
params.label: Year the swarm wakes (years into the game)

params.name: probeSwarmTechLevel
params.label: Tech level of its ships and stations

params.name: probeSwarmStationDays
params.label: Days between new mining stations (in a galaxy of the reference size)

params.name: probeSwarmStationRefStars
params.label: Reference galaxy size for that interval (stars; bigger galaxies expand proportionally faster)

params.name: probeSwarmStationMinDays
params.label: Shortest interval between new mining stations (days)

params.name: probeSwarmAvoidColonies

params.name: probeSwarmExpandRangePct

params.name: probeSwarmMinCapitalDistancePct
params.label: Least distance of the mothercore from any capital (% of the galaxy width)

params.name: probeSwarmSalvageResearch
